forbidden_for_public_repo: platform posts with unclear reuse rights

sources.name: ZhiXing curated public destination sample
sources.m1_usage: Small public sample documents for retrieval evaluation and safe demo copy.
sources.ingestion_boundary: Must be clearly marked as demo/reference content and cannot claim realtime price, inventory, booking or supplier confirmation.
sources.raw_cache_policy: No raw external cache is required.

sources.name: Wikivoyage
sources.m1_usage: Destination overview, background, transport and travel caution references.
sources.ingestion_boundary: Use small attributed extracts or manually curated summaries; record page URL, license, retrieved_at and attribution.
sources.raw_cache_policy: Raw dumps stay outside Git; commit only curated Markdown with attribution.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.m1_usage: Small-city POI metadata, tourism tags, coordinates and map candidate evidence.
sources.ingestion_boundary: Use small scoped Overpass queries; preserve attribution and avoid presenting derived data as proprietary inventory.
sources.raw_cache_policy: Raw Overpass responses stay outside Git; commit only small attributed metadata samples if reviewed.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.m1_usage: Small image metadata cards and attribution examples for multimodal RAG demos.
sources.ingestion_boundary: Record file page, author, license and source URL per asset; do not bulk-download media into Git.
sources.raw_cache_policy: Images and API responses stay outside Git; commit only reviewed metadata cards.

sources.name: Natural Earth
sources.m1_usage: Optional map background or geography reference, not required for M1 travel planning.
sources.ingestion_boundary: Use only if a release needs lightweight map context; do not commit full datasets unless separately approved.
sources.raw_cache_policy: Raw files stay outside Git unless a tiny reviewed sample is explicitly approved.

sources.name: GeoNames
sources.ingestion_boundary: Use only reviewed subsets with attribution; do not commit full dumps.
